lastMessages:
worker:  `npm test` passes all 10 tests, including the existing JSON export test. I committed both files, and `git status` is clean. Nothing else changed.

The export follows the rules you listed, including quoting only fields that contain a comma, double quote, CR or LF. I used `String(value ?? '')` and kept the style of `json.js`, with no shared helper. The tests assert exact strings with explicit `\uFEFF` and `\r\n` escapes. They cover every case in your list; I also added a case with a bare CR in a field.

Git printed a warning that LF in the two new files will be replaced by CRLF the next time it touches them. I did not change any git settings. The warning didn't affect the commit or the tests.
